name: magtag_2.9_grayscale
title: Adafruit MagTag 2.9" grayscale (ESP32-S2), including the 2025 Edition with the SSD1680 display
notes: Partitions (TinyUF2 and CircuitPython agree): nvs 0x9000, otadata 0xe000, ota_0 0x10000 (CircuitPython), uf2 0x2d0000 (TinyUF2, factory app), ffat 0x310000 (CIRCUITPY).
CircuitPython's full .bin covers otadata with 0xFF, which makes the board boot TinyUF2; cpfleet writes an otadata entry selecting ota_0.

Switched to the ROM bootloader by software (microcontroller.RunMode.BOOTLOADER), the board reboots a few seconds after each esptool session ends (and after chip-id), so cpfleet does each step in its own session right after switching, and writes the whole new flash as one image. That reboot also means no Reset is needed afterwards.
esptool's own reset (--after hard-reset) leaves the board off USB until Reset is pressed, so cpfleet always uses --after no-reset.
ROM download mode by hand: hold Boot, press and release Reset, release Boot. USB 303a:0002. A board in download mode by hand stays there until reset.
The USB console sometimes stops taking input while still sending output (a reset clears it); cpfleet then uses the board's Wi-Fi console, matching the USB port name to the board's UID.
